summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Sabesp, a Brazilian water utility, notifying the market that it filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025. The filing contains no special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. It is an ordinary annual reporting compliance update under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, with no transactional terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. There is no deal to analyze; the filing simply confirms the annual report's availability. As a regulatory filing lacking any corporate action, it does not qualify as a special situation.
